column1: # PLANTS_MIDROW_release_N.tsv: planted-failure controls of the two middle-row runs, read by plants_midrow.py. Each row repeats the
# run's command with the assembly program's own plant PLANT (kt_mr_assembly_v1_8_4.py, its fifth argument) and expects its console to
# state 'PLANT <name>: FIRED'. The 11 plants that apply in CERTIFIED mode (the mode of both runs) and fire on their own gate. Three more
# were tried (consoles kept): PROD and CSTAT test stand-in records only; OPN on nM2 makes the run fail through the margin rule (1 FAIL row),
# not at G-POS, so by the program's rule it does not fire. Columns: id, run (RUNS_M2_release_N.tsv), plant, expected word.
